$comment: Source of truth for the asset library. One entry per pack. `from` says where the pack comes from inside LIB_SRC (a zip, a directory, or loose files); `dest` is the URL prefix on the CDN (a string, or a map of source-prefix -> dest-prefix, longest prefix wins); `skip` are regexes on the source path; `only` keeps just those source prefixes; `handler` picks a special build routine. url/author/license/price are the facts from the pack's page (checked 15 Sep 2026); `licenseFile` quotes the licence shipped inside the zip; `commercial` is yes | credit (yes, attribution required): packs whose free tier is personal-use only or whose origin is unknown are not in the library; `credit` is the attribution line to ship when required. Frame metadata: `cell` [w,h] is the pack-wide grid cell, `cells` maps a path regex (relative to dest) to a cell for files that differ, `animations` maps a name to {row, frames} for sheets laid out one animation per row, `fps` is the intended playback rate, `sequences: true` means one PNG per frame named <Anim>_<n>.png (the build groups them into <Anim>.json). `from.npm` + `from.version` stages a package from npm (npm pack), for libraries hosted under vendor/. `from.repo` points inside library/ (the starter maps live in library/maps).
